_schema.description: The VEC's official list of candidates for the 2026 state election (nominations closed 12 noon Mon 9 Nov 2026; ballot draw 4 pm that day), read from the VEC's nominations page for each district and region and its spreadsheet of all candidates. Facts only: no contact details or localities are kept. Rewritten by scripts/vec_nominations.py (refresh.py runs it nightly, and every run until the ballot order is published); candidates.json and regions.json are brought into line with it.

fields.source: {label, url (the VEC's 2026 election page), spreadsheet_url, spreadsheet_as_at (as printed on it)}
fields.fetched: ISO UTC time the VEC pages were last read
fields.ballot_drawn: true once every nominations page lists candidates in ballot-paper order
fields.totals: {candidates, assembly, council, independents (Assembly independents plus Council candidates with no registered party), by_party: {code: count, both houses}, assembly_by_party, council_by_party}
fields.districts: {district id: {name, url, vacancies, ballot_drawn, candidates: [{ballot_name (as on the ballot, 'SURNAME, Given'), name ('Given Surname', the tracker's display spelling), party (code; IND for independents), party_label (as the VEC prints it; null for independents), ballot_position (null until the draw), nominated (order on the pre-draw list), id (candidate id in the tracker)}]}}
fields.regions: {region id: {name, url, vacancies, ballot_drawn, groups: [{group (letter), label (as printed), party (code), candidates: [names in group order]}], candidates: [as for districts, plus group (letter, null if ungrouped) and group_position (position within the group)]}}
fields.changes: What the last run found different from the run before: [{date, kind (added | removed | renamed | party | ballot_position | group | drawn), contest, name, detail}], newest first, last 200
